title.zh: 将南甘马粦省卡拉班加市镇比纳努阿南的Calabanga国立中学附属校分离，单独改设为独立的Medrozo-Mendoza国立中学，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Separating the Calabanga National High School - Medrozo-Mendoza High School Annex in Binanuaanan Pequeño, Calabanga, Camarines Sur From the Calabanga National High School and Converting the Same Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as the Medrozo-Mendoza National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Calabanga National High School - Medrozo-Mendoza High School Annex in Binanuaanan Pequeño, Calabanga, Camarines Sur From the Calabanga National High School and Converting the Same Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as the Medrozo-Mendoza National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Medrozo-Mendoza High School của Trường Trung học Calabanga Quốc gia tại Tỉnh Calabanga, Tỉnh Camarines Sur khỏi Trường Trung học Calabanga Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Medrozo-Mendoza Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Medrozo-Mendoza High School ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Calabanga แห่งชาติในจังหวัด Calabanga จังหวัด Camarines Sur ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Calabanga แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Medrozo-Mendoza แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Medrozo-Mendoza High School, Sekolah Menengah Calabanga Nasional di Provinsi Calabanga, Provinsi Camarines Sur dari Sekolah Menengah Calabanga Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Medrozo-Mendoza Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Medrozo-Mendoza High School, Sekolah Menengah Calabanga Kebangsaan di Wilayah Calabanga, Wilayah Camarines Sur daripada Sekolah Menengah Calabanga Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Medrozo-Mendoza Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Calabanga National High School -Medrozo-Mendoza High School Annex in Binanuaanan Pequeño, Calabanga, Camarines Sur is hereby separated from the Calabanga National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as the Medrozo-Mendoza National High School.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.

All personnel, records, assets and liabilities of the Calabanga National High School - Medrozo-Mendoza High School Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Medrozo-Mendoza National High School.

The amount necessary for the initial implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Calabanga National High School - Medrozo-Mendoza High School Annex. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the operation and maintenance of the Medrozo-Mendoza National High School shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
